description: PLANNED (plan T14 R1; OpenVibe.Run is not built yet): Cancel one of the token project's jobs: POST /api/v1/jobs/:id/cancel. A queued or placed job never starts; a running one is killed (platform.job-frame@1 job_cancel); cancelling an ended job changes nothing and answers it as it is. It becomes active, and enters generated/openapi/run.json, when OpenVibe.Run implements the routes.
